{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")

duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {len(duplicates)}")

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated
print(f"Duplicated patient_ids: {duplicates['patient_id'].unique()}")"}
